title: What if it rained homework? (Vex lives through a what-if sim: drizzle -> showers -> buried cars -> paper tornado -> flooded town -> paper tsunami -> one Scribe scan -> the rain flies back up)

voice.name: Dolly (generic Fish library voice, breathy British; the user's pick, alternating with Mommy)

beats.say: What if it rained homework? Like, actually rained.
It starts as a drizzle. One worksheet. Cute.
Then showers. The umbrella is not helping.
By noon, the cars are gone. Buried in chemistry.
Then a tornado. Made entirely of essays.
By four, the whole town is underwater. I'm surfing a desk.
Relax, babe. I don't panic. I scan.
Scribe solves all twelve pages, in my handwriting. Lewis structures included.
Turns out it only rains when it's not done.
Tomorrow's forecast? Zero percent homework. You're welcome.
